name: recover-pilot-ab
note: A/B PILOT config (NOT the frozen baseline). 2 targets x 3 difficulties x 1 rep = 6 runs, spread across the matrix for a quick, cheap comparison. Model, prompts, difficulties and max_attempts are identical to the frozen scenarios.json; only reps is reduced for the pilot. Run the SAME file at two code commits: A = P1-only (verifier fix, original prompt, commit 2a07306) and B = P1+P0 (verifier fix + improved prompt, commit a9c0130). The campaign fingerprint embeds the git commit, so A and B land in separate datasets automatically. The baseline recover-pilot v1 (commit 43e3619, 0/18) stays untouched for comparison.
